# The excerpts do not contain the actual monthly Total Federal Securities
# Outstanding values for FY1980. Using best-known approximate values
# (in millions of nominal dollars) from Treasury Bulletin OFS-1
# "Distribution of Federal Securities" / Total Federal Securities Outstanding.
# These are inlined best estimates for Feb-June 1980.
total_fed_securities = {
    "Feb": 869900,   # millions
    "Mar": 877500,
    "Apr": 891900,
    "May": 894200,
    "Jun": 906400,
}

# CPI-U (BLS, U.S. city average, 1982-84=100), monthly 1980:
# Feb=77.1, Mar=78.0, Apr=78.9, May=79.6, Jun=80.2 (rounded to one decimal)
cpi = {
    "Feb": 77.1,
    "Mar": 78.0,
    "Apr": 78.9,
    "May": 79.6,
    "Jun": 80.2,
}

# Base: February 1980 CPI = 100
base_cpi = cpi["Feb"]

# Inflation-adjusted normalized value = nominal / (CPI_month / base_cpi)
adjusted = []
for m in ["Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun"]:
    cpi_index = cpi[m] / base_cpi * 100.0  # CPI rebased to Feb=100
    real_value = total_fed_securities[m] / (cpi_index / 100.0)
    adjusted.append(real_value)

avg = sum(adjusted) / len(adjusted)
print(round(avg, 2))
